description: Source code implementing PKCS#7 parsing and handling functions in OpenSSL, including header parsing, certificate extraction, and signing data construction.

methods.name: pkcs7_parse_header
methods.description: Parses the header of a PKCS#7 SignedData blob, handling BER/DER formats and extracting the main content.

methods.name: PKCS7_get_raw_certificates
methods.description: Extracts raw certificates from a PKCS#7 SignedData structure into a stack of CRYPTO_BUFFER objects.

methods.name: PKCS7_bundle_raw_certificates
methods.description: Creates a PKCS#7 SignedData structure containing raw certificates.

methods.name: pkcs7_add_signed_data
methods.description: Constructs a PKCS#7 SignedData structure with optional digest algorithms, certificates, and signer info.
